First checked bag free for the cardmember and up to three companions on the same reservation on JetBlue-operated flights. 5,000 TrueBlue points each anniversary; 10% of points back after eligible JetBlue-operated award travel; $100 JetBlue Vacations credit each anniversary year; 50% back on eligible inflight food and drinks. 1 Mosaic tile per $1,000 spent ($50,000 in a calendar year reaches Mosaic 1).

cards.name: United Explorer Card
cards.note: United's mid-tier co-brand and the second United card in the catalog after the United Club Card. The annual fee rose from $95 to $150 in the 2026 refresh; the $200 annual TravelBank credit belongs to the pricier Quest, not this card — the Explorer instead earns a $100 United travel credit after $10,000 in annual spend. Free first checked bag for the cardmember and one companion, Group 2 priority boarding, and 2 United Club one-time passes per year cover the fee for anyone flying United a few times a year. A 10,000-mile award flight discount unlocks after $20,000 in annual spend, plus over $500 in narrow partner credits (Instacart+, rideshare, Avis/Budget, JSX). Intro offers omitted as they change often; verify current terms on the issuer's site before applying.
cards.rewards_summary: 9x total miles on eligible United flights (6x MileagePlus member miles on the fare plus 3x on the card); 3x on all other eligible United purchases; 2x on hotel stays booked with the hotel and on dining; 1x elsewhere. Up to $120 Global Entry/TSA PreCheck/NEXUS credit every 4 years; 25% back on United inflight purchases; no foreign transaction fees.

cards.name: Delta SkyMiles Platinum American Express Card
cards.note: The mid-tier Delta co-brand, sitting between the Gold ($150, already in the catalog) and the Reserve. The annual companion certificate is the whole argument: after each renewal it covers a companion's round-trip Main Cabin ticket (U.S., Mexico, Caribbean, Central America; not Basic Economy) for taxes and fees only, so one trip can cover the $350 fee — but no certificate arrives in year one. The 2,500 MQD head start each year is half the 5,000 MQDs needed for Silver Medallion, plus 1 MQD per $20 spent. Up to $390 a year in narrow credits ($150 Delta Stays, $10/month Resy, $10/month rideshare; enrollment required). No Sky Club access. Intro offers omitted as they change often; verify current terms on the issuer's site before applying.
cards.rewards_summary: 3x miles on Delta purchases and hotels booked directly with the hotel; 2x at restaurants worldwide and U.S. supermarkets; 1x elsewhere. Annual companion certificate after renewal (round-trip Main Cabin, companion pays taxes and fees). First checked bag free for the cardholder and up to 8 companions on the same reservation, second bag free for the cardholder on domestic flights; priority boarding. 15% off Delta award flights (TakeOff 15); Global Entry/TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years; 20% back on Delta inflight purchases; no foreign transaction fees.

cards.name: Southwest Rapid Rewards Priority Credit Card
cards.note: Chase's top personal Southwest card and the second Southwest co-brand in the catalog (the $99 Plus is already here). The 2025 refresh removed the old $75 annual Southwest travel credit and the four upgraded boardings, so the $229 fee now has to be justified by seating: a free Preferred seat at booking and free Extra Legroom upgrades within 48 hours of departure (when available), for the cardholder and up to eight companions. The 7,500 anniversary points are worth roughly $94 at TPG's October 2026 valuation, leaving about $135 of fee to cover with the seat and bag perks. Southwest announced further Rapid Rewards changes effective December 2, 2026 — verify current terms on the issuer's site before applying. Intro offers omitted as they change often.
cards.rewards_summary: 4x points on Southwest purchases; 2x at gas stations and restaurants; 5x on Lyft through 12/31/2027; 1x elsewhere. 7,500 anniversary points each year. Free first checked bag for the cardholder and up to eight companions on the same reservation; Group 5 boarding. 25% back on inflight purchases including Wi-Fi. 10,000-point Companion Pass qualifying boost in 2026; 2,500 tier qualifying points per $5,000 spent in 2026 (from 2027, 1 TQP per $1 spent). No foreign transaction fees.

cards.name: Hilton Honors American Express Surpass Card
cards.note: The mid-tier Hilton card, between the $0 Hilton Honors Amex (already in the catalog) and the $550 Aspire. The $150 fee is covered on paper by the $200 annual Hilton credit (up to $50 per quarter on Hilton stays), but only if you actually stay at Hiltons every quarter. Complimentary Gold status (80% bonus on base points, space-available upgrades, fifth night free on points stays) is the real everyday value; the Free Night Reward after $15,000 in a calendar year is the second. Spend $40,000 in a calendar year and it upgrades you to Diamond through the end of the next calendar year. Intro offers omitted as they change often; verify current terms on the issuer's site before applying.
cards.rewards_summary: 12x points on Hilton portfolio purchases; 6x at U.S. restaurants, U.S. supermarkets, and U.S. gas stations; 4x on U.S. online retail purchases; 3x elsewhere. Complimentary Hilton Honors Gold status. Up to $200 in Hilton statement credits per year ($50 per quarter). Free Night Reward after $15,000 spent in a calendar year. No foreign transaction fees.
sources: americanexpress.com (Hilton Honors Surpass card page, Nov 2026)
bankrate.com (Hilton Honors Surpass Card review, 2026)
nerdwallet.com (Hilton Amex Surpass review, 2026)

cards.note: The top of the Hilton ladder, above the $0 Hilton Honors Amex and the $150 Surpass (both already in the catalog). The $550 fee is covered on paper by the credits alone — $400/yr Hilton resort credit ($200 per half-year) plus $200/yr flight credit ($50 per quarter) — but only if you actually use them at Hilton resorts and on flights. The real headline is complimentary Diamond status (100% bonus on base points, space-available upgrades, executive lounge access at select properties) plus a Free Night Reward every year, including the first year, with more after $30,000 and $60,000 in calendar-year spend. Also includes a $219 CLEAR+ credit. Only worth it if you stay at Hiltons often enough to use the resort credit and the free night; otherwise the Surpass is the better buy. Intro offers omitted as they change often; verify current terms on the issuer's site before applying.
cards.rewards_summary: 14x points on Hilton portfolio purchases; 7x on flights booked directly with airlines or through American Express Travel, select car rentals, and U.S. restaurants; 3x elsewhere. Complimentary Hilton Honors Diamond status. Up to $400 in Hilton resort statement credits per year ($200 semi-annually). Up to $200 in flight statement credits per year ($50 per quarter). Annual Free Night Reward, plus one after $30,000 and another after $60,000 spent in a calendar year. $219 CLEAR+ credit. No foreign transaction fees.
sources: americanexpress.com (Hilton Honors Aspire card page, Nov 2026)
